name: K15
summary: K15 is Anyverse Dynamics' second-generation wheeled humanoid robot. It combines two articulated arms and hands with a height-adjustable upper body and a wheeled base. The manufacturer positions it for dexterous manipulation in industrial and commercial environments and integrates it with its embodied-intelligence software. Manufacturer statements describe initial deliveries; current stock and customer-specific configuration have not been independently verified.
